title: Book Three · Chapter 140: The Bus Fares Below
story:
Two weeks later, Ronan has replies from both places.

The centre's letter came on Friday. Leo's twentieth reply arrives on Monday.

Ronan reads Leo's first. His friend has drawn a tiny goal near the top. There is a little goalkeeper inside it. He is facing the ball.

Jun sent long passes too, Leo writes. Ask him about those.

Ronan laughs. There is news about Leo's classmates below the drawing. One friend has found a shorter walk to school. They are trying it together that week.

Afterward, Ronan opens the course sheet again.

The centre describes an introductory course. It has six Saturday mornings, nine until twelve. The current fee is eighteen yuan, with practice paper included.

The next starting date is not on the sheet. The letter says it will be confirmed later.

Ronan puts his work envelope beside the page. Twenty-one yuan remains inside.

He nearly puts a mark beside eighteen. Then he remembers the bus.

One yuan there and one back. Six visits make twelve yuan for travel.

He writes twelve below the fee and adds them.

Thirty.

Mum comes to the table to find her scissors. Ronan moves the course sheet so she can reach the box.

“Thirty for the lessons and the bus,” he says.

She looks at the two lines.

“At these prices.”

“Yes. And the dates are still missing.”

He has older personal money too. He leaves both that money and the work envelope in their places.

He wants the timetable before he pays for anything.

After dinner, he reads the description of the lessons. There are customer notes, simple letters, and number work. Students practise with examples from shops and offices.

Dad reads one short part beside him.

“The totals still need to be right,” he says.

“Even with a good voice.”

Dad smiles. “Especially then. People may listen.”

Ronan takes his pencil and writes Starting Date on his question list. He puts a question mark beside those words.

The next day, he tells Anna about the six mornings. She asks about the written work, and he shows her the short list.

“Would you like that?” she asks.

“I want to try more.”

She nods and gives him the sheet back. Then she takes out her own maths book.

Ronan opens his school work beside it. Before the lesson begins, he draws one more very small goal for Leo and leaves the ball a little closer this time.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

introductory＝入门的；included＝已包含在内的；confirm＝确认；timetable＝具体时间安排。

## 理解问题

1. 十八元课程费之外，六次往返按现价还需多少？合计多少？
2. Ronan是否已经报名或付款？还缺哪一项重要时间信息？

## 读句子

**He wants the timetable before he pays for anything.**

拆开看：He / wants the timetable / before he pays for anything.

他／想先拿到具体时间表／再决定并支付费用。
